minutes.headline: EDC elected Josie Gilchrist chair, Anna Lockwood vice chair, and will hold the town meet-and-greet in early October
minutes.summary: The Economic Development Committee reorganized, electing Josie Gilchrist as chair and Anna Lockwood as vice chair after discussion of the committee's chronic scheduling and structural problems. Members debated at length whether to postpone the annual town official meet-and-greet given the planning office's vacant land use director and conservation agent positions, ultimately deciding to proceed in early October at Smoke Stack Coffee Roasters via a small subgroup. The committee also deferred a broader rewrite of its charge/mission until after a land use director is hired, agreed to survey members on future meeting times, and arranged for minutes going forward to be produced by Danielle from meeting recordings.

what_happened.line: The committee reorganized, electing Josie Gilchrist chair and Anna Lockwood vice chair by roll-call vote.
Members chose to hold the annual town official meet-and-greet as planned in early October, despite two vacant planning office positions.
A subgroup, not the full committee, was authorized to make on-the-ground decisions for that event.
A rewrite of the committee's own charge and mission was postponed until a land use director is hired.
Minutes for future meetings will be produced by Danielle from recordings, addressing a backlog of unapproved past minutes.

why_it_matters: The meet-and-greet is a public event connecting residents and officials, and it is proceeding despite a planning department that is currently short two positions.
How this committee defines its own charge affects what economic development work Lunenburg pursues going forward, and that decision is on hold pending a hire outside the committee's control.
A committee that had fallen behind on producing its own minutes is putting a fixed process in place, which affects how easily residents can review what it decided.
watch_next: The early-October meet-and-greet at Smoke Stack Coffee Roasters, once the subgroup finalizes details
Results of the member survey on future meeting day/time, and whether a land use director is hired before the charge/mission rewrite resumes

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on both officer elections, with the same outcomes and roll calls, and on most of the event-planning and scheduling items; the differences are mostly name spellings. The thing to check is the discussion near the end: the official minutes record no $1,200 figure, treat the missing minutes as approved but unposted, and record no decision to send recordings to Danielle.
